turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds perfect for a warm Phoenix day! Are you gearing up for another shift at the ER tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yep, getting ready to head in soon. I just finished packing my bag. For my lunch break later, I'm bringing yesterday's extra enchiladas that I boxed up.

turns.text: Leftover enchiladas are always a win for a busy shift! How is your commute looking tonight? Taking the usual, or something different?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A good laugh is the best preparation for a night in the ER! Speaking of good moods, how have things been with Tom lately? Have you two had any time to catch up?

turns.text: Things with Tom are great! We actually grabbed a quick dinner together yesterday before I started prepping my leftovers. He's doing really well.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful to hear. It's always nice to squeeze in some quality time. Have you had any time for your sourdough starter lately, or has the hospital been too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My starter is actually sitting happy in the fridge right now. I think I'll bake a fresh loaf later this week when my schedule clears up. I need to get heading out for that bus now, though!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Have a safe ride and a smooth, quiet night at the hospital, Sofia! Talk to you tomorrow!
